<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr"><head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Burdigala Diagnostics — Centre de gestion</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" media="print" onload="this.media='all'">
<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json">
<link rel="icon" href="icon-192.png">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="icon-192.png">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0E1311">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Burdigala CRM">

<style>
:root{
  /* ---- Design tokens (thème pro) ---- */
  --bg:#F6F7F9; --card:#FFFFFF; --line:#E4E7EC; --line-2:#EEF0F3;
  --ink:#101828; --ink-2:#344054; --muted:#667085; --subtle:#98A2B3;
  --green:#4E8F2E; --green-d:#3F7A23; --green-soft:#ECF5E6; --green-tint:#F4F9F0; --brand:#6DB33F;
  --amber:#B54708; --amber-soft:#FFFAEB; --red:#D92D20; --red-soft:#FEF3F2; --blue:#4E8F2E; --blue-soft:#F4F9F0;
  --side:#0E1311; --side-2:#161C19; --side-tx:#AEB5BD; --side-hd:#69727C;
  --r:12px; --r-sm:8px;
  --sh:0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.05); --sh-h:0 4px 12px rgba(16,24,40,.08);
  --ring:0 0 0 3px rgba(78,143,46,.18);
  --font:"Inter",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --bg-grad:var(--bg);
  --on-bg:var(--ink); --on-bg-2:var(--muted);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}

/* ---------- Écran de connexion ---------- */
#loginGate{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:32px;padding:40px 20px;
  background:radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 50% -10%,#1E2A23 0%,rgba(14,19,17,0) 60%),var(--side);}
#loginGate.hidden{display:none;}
#loginGate .lg-logo{width:min(300px,70vw);height:auto;display:block;}
#loginGate .lg-card{width:100%;max-width:400px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:14px;padding:28px;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45);}
#loginGate form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;}
#loginGate .lg-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;}
#loginGate .lg-field label{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-2);}
#loginGate .lg-inp{font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;border:1px solid #D0D5DD;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;width:100%;box-shadow:var(--sh);transition:border-color .14s,box-shadow .14s;}
#loginGate .lg-inp::placeholder{color:var(--subtle);}
#loginGate .lg-inp:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--ring);}
#loginGate .lg-pw{position:relative;}
#loginGate .lg-pw .lg-inp{padding-right:62px;}
#loginGate .lg-see{position:absolute;right:6px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);background:none;border:none;font-family:inherit;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:6px;}
#loginGate .lg-see:hover{color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg);}
#loginGate .lg-cta{font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;background:var(--green);border:1px solid var(--green);border-radius:8px;padding:11px 16px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--sh);transition:background .14s;}
#loginGate .lg-cta:hover{background:var(--green-d);}
#loginGate .lg-cta:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:default;}
#loginGate .lg-err{display:none;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:#B42318;background:var(--red-soft);border:1px solid #FECDCA;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;}
#loginGate .lg-err.show{display:block;}
#loginGate .lg-switch{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;}
#loginGate .lg-switch a{color:var(--green);font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;}
#loginGate .lg-switch a:hover{text-decoration:underline;}

html,body{margin:0;height:100%;}
body{font-family:var(--font);color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg);
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;line-height:1.5;font-size:14px;font-feature-settings:"cv11","ss01";}
button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;} a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
svg{fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:10px;height:10px;} ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#D0D5DD;border-radius:6px;border:3px solid var(--bg);} ::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent;}
.app{display:flex;height:100vh;overflow:hidden;}

/* ---------- Sidebar ---------- */
.side{width:248px;flex:0 0 248px;background:var(--side);color:var(--side-tx);display:flex;flex-direction:column;z-index:56;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);overflow:hidden;}
.side-brand{padding:18px 2px 15px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);flex:0 0 auto;}
button.side-brand{background:none;border:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);width:100%;display:block;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;}
.side-brand img{width:244px;height:69px;max-width:none;display:block;margin:0 auto;image-rendering:auto;}
.side-nav{padding:10px 12px;flex:1;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-start;}
.side-nav::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
@media (max-height:760px){
  .nsec{padding:12px 10px 4px;}
  .nav-item{padding:6px 10px;margin-bottom:1px;}
  .side-brand{padding:12px 2px 10px;}
}
@media (max-height:620px){
  .nsec{padding:8px 10px 3px;font-size:10.5px;}
  .nav-item{padding:4px 10px;margin-bottom:0;font-size:13px;}
  .nav-item svg{width:16px;height:16px;}
  .side-brand{padding:8px 2px 7px;}
  .side-foot{padding:8px 12px;}
  .side-btn{padding:6px 10px;font-size:12.5px;}
}
.side-nav::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);border:2px solid transparent;}
.nsec{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--side-hd);padding:18px 10px 6px;}
.nav-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:6px;color:var(--side-tx);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;width:100%;text-align:left;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;position:relative;margin-bottom:2px;transition:background .12s,color .12s;}
.nav-item svg{width:17px;height:17px;color:#7D8690;flex:0 0 auto;transition:color .12s;}
.nav-item:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);color:#F2F4F7;} .nav-item:hover svg{color:#C9CED6;}
.nav-item.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#fff;} .nav-item.active svg{color:var(--brand);}
.nav-item.active::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-12px;top:7px;bottom:7px;width:3px;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;background:var(--brand);}
.nav-item .badge{margin-left:auto;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:#C9CED6;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;border-radius:999px;padding:0 7px;line-height:18px;min-width:20px;text-align:center;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
.nav-item.active .badge{background:rgba(109,179,63,.2);color:#CDE8BA;}
.side-foot{padding:12px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);flex:0 0 auto;}
.user{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 8px 10px;}
.ava{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;}
.user .un{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;} .user .ur{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--side-tx);}
.side-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}
.side-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;width:100%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);color:#E4E7EC;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s;}
.side-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.16);color:#fff;}
.side-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px;flex:0 0 auto;}
.side-btn.primary{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#E4E7EC;}
.side-btn.primary:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.16);}

/* ---------- Content ---------- */
.content{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100vh;background:var(--bg);position:relative;}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;border:1px solid #D0D5DD;background:var(--card);color:var(--ink-2);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;font-family:inherit;line-height:1.35;box-shadow:var(--sh);transition:background .15s,border-color .15s,color .15s;}
.btn:hover{background:#F9FAFB;color:var(--ink);}
.btn svg{width:15px;height:15px;}
.btn.dark{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink);color:#fff;} .btn.dark:hover{background:#1D2939;border-color:#1D2939;}
.btn.green{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff;} .btn.green:hover{background:var(--green-d);border-color:var(--green-d);}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed;pointer-events:none;}
.btn.sm{padding:5px 10px;font-size:12.5px;border-radius:7px;}
.btn:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:var(--ring);}

.body{flex:1;position:relative;min-height:0;}
.pages{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;}

/* framehost (modules) */
.framehost{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;background:var(--bg);}
.framehost.active{display:flex;}
.frames{flex:1;position:relative;}
.frames iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;display:none;background:var(--bg);}
.frames iframe.active{display:block;}
.floader{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;}
.floader.show{display:flex;}
.spin{width:22px;height:22px;border:2px solid var(--line);border-top-color:var(--green);border-radius:50%;animation:sp .7s linear infinite;}
@keyframes sp{to{transform:rotate(360deg);}}

.view{padding:28px 32px 48px;max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;color:var(--ink);}
.view.hidden{display:none;}
.hidden{display:none!important;}
.hello{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.hello h2{font-family:inherit;font-weight:600;font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 4px;color:var(--ink);}
.hello p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;}

.kpis{display:grid;gap:16px;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);margin-top:24px;}
.kpi{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:18px 20px;box-shadow:var(--sh);transition:box-shadow .15s,border-color .15s;}
.kpi:hover{box-shadow:var(--sh-h);}
.kpi-link{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;}
.kpi-link:hover{border-color:#D0D5DD;}
.kpi .h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;}
.kpi .ic{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--green-tint);color:var(--green);border:1px solid #DDEBD3;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;}
.kpi .ic svg{width:16px;height:16px;}
.kpi .ic.amber{background:var(--amber-soft);color:var(--amber);border-color:#FEDF89;} .kpi .ic.blue{background:var(--blue-soft);color:var(--blue);border-color:#C9E3B5;}
.kpi .v{font-size:28px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.1;margin-top:16px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink);}
.kpi .l{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px;}

.grid{display:grid;gap:16px;margin-top:16px;}
/* tableau de bord : 2 lignes de 3 cartes */
.dash-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:16px;}
.tree-strip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px;padding:14px 18px;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#EDF7E2,#F6FAF2);border:1px solid #D6E8C6;color:#2F5A17;}
.tree-strip .ts-ic{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0;}
.tree-strip .ts-ic svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:#3F7A1F;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
.tree-strip .ts-n{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.3px;color:#1F3D0F;}
.tree-strip .ts-t{font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;flex:1;min-width:180px;}
.tree-strip .ts-due{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;background:#fff;border:1px solid #D6E8C6;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px;cursor:pointer;color:#2F5A17;}
.ap-star{color:#E0A100;font-size:15px;margin-left:6px;vertical-align:-1px;}
.dash-row.r1{margin-top:24px;}
.dcard{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;}
.dcard-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;padding:16px 18px;border:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);background:none;font:inherit;color:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;border-radius:var(--r) var(--r) 0 0;}
.dcard-h:hover{background:#FAFBFA;}
.dcard-h .ic{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--green-tint);color:var(--green);border:1px solid #DDEBD3;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;}
.dcard-h .ic svg{width:16px;height:16px;}
.dcard-h .ic.amber{background:var(--amber-soft);color:var(--amber);border-color:#FEDF89;} .dcard-h .ic.blue{background:var(--blue-soft);color:var(--blue);border-color:#C9E3B5;}
.dcard-h .t{flex:1;min-width:0;font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.25;}
.dcard-h .t small{display:block;font-weight:500;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;}
.dcard-h .v{font-size:24px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;}
.dlist{padding:4px 18px 12px;flex:1;}
.dli{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);cursor:pointer;}
.dli:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.dli .a{flex:1;min-width:0;} .dli .a b{display:block;font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.dli .a span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.dli .m{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-2);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap;}
.dli .hr{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue);min-width:42px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
.dli .a span.late{display:inline-block;vertical-align:1px;}
.dli .late{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#B42318;background:#FEF3F2;border-radius:999px;padding:1px 7px;margin-left:6px;}
.dempty{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);padding:14px 0 6px;line-height:1.5;}
.dmore{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--green);font-weight:600;padding-top:8px;cursor:pointer;}
.dsub{padding:10px 18px 0;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;}
.dsub b{color:var(--ink-2);}
.dcard .chart{padding:12px 18px 10px;}
.dcard .bars{height:150px;gap:8px;}
.bar.b2{background:#9CC97A;}
.bstack{width:100%;max-width:36px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column-reverse;}
.bstack .bar{max-width:none;border-radius:0;}
.bstack .bar:last-child{border-radius:4px 4px 0 0;}
.dleg{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:8px 18px 14px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);}
.dleg i{display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:2px;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:-1px;background:var(--brand);}
.dleg i.b2{background:#9CC97A;}
@media (max-width:1100px){ .dash-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;} }
@media (max-width:720px){ .dash-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
.g-2{grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr;}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);box-shadow:var(--sh);}
.card-h{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);min-height:54px;}
.card-h h3{font-family:inherit;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:var(--ink);}
.card-h .hint{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);}
.card-h button:not(.btn){font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--green);background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:6px;}
.card-h button:not(.btn):hover{background:var(--green-tint);}
.card-b{padding:8px 20px 16px;}

/* chart */
.chart{padding:18px 20px 10px;}
.bars{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:14px;height:180px;padding-top:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);}
.bcol{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:100%;justify-content:flex-end;}
.bwrap{width:100%;flex:1;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;}
.bar{width:100%;max-width:36px;margin:0 auto;background:var(--brand);border-radius:4px 4px 0 0;min-height:3px;transition:height .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);}
.bl{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;} .bv{font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-2);font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}

/* lists */
.act{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);align-items:center;}
.act:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.act .ai{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px;flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:1px solid var(--line);}
.act .ai svg{width:15px;height:15px;} .ai.g{background:var(--green-tint);color:var(--green);border-color:#DDEBD3;} .ai.b{background:var(--blue-soft);color:var(--blue);border-color:#C9E3B5;} .ai.a{background:var(--amber-soft);color:var(--amber);border-color:#FEDF89;}
.act .at{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.3;color:var(--ink);} .act .am{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:1px;} .act .tm{margin-left:auto;font-size:12px;color:var(--subtle);white-space:nowrap;}
.rdv{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);align-items:center;} .rdv:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.rdv .w{flex:0 0 52px;text-align:center;} .rdv .w .d{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;} .rdv .w .h{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink);}
.rdv .bar2{width:3px;align-self:stretch;background:var(--brand);border-radius:2px;}
.rdv .who{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);} .rdv .what{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:1px;}

/* tables */
.vhead{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:6px;}
.vhead .lead{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;margin:0;max-width:760px;}
.search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:1px solid #D0D5DD;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;padding:0 12px;max-width:340px;width:100%;box-shadow:var(--sh);}
.search:focus-within{border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--ring);}
.search svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--subtle);} .search input{border:none;outline:none;padding:9px 0;font:inherit;font-size:14px;flex:1;background:none;color:var(--ink);}
.tbl-wrap{overflow-x:auto;max-width:100%;}
table.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:560px;}
table.tbl th{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;text-align:left;padding:11px 20px;background:#F9FAFB;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap;}
table.tbl td{padding:13px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-2);}
.tbl-inp{width:100%;min-width:0;max-width:170px;box-sizing:border-box;border:1px solid #D0D5DD;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px;font:inherit;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.tbl-inp:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--ring);}
table.tbl tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;} table.tbl tbody tr:hover td{background:#F9FAFB;}
.card > .tbl-wrap{border-radius:var(--r);}
.tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid transparent;line-height:1.5;white-space:nowrap;}
.tag::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;opacity:.85;}
.tag.ok{color:#067647;background:#ECFDF3;border-color:#ABEFC6;} .tag.wait{color:var(--amber);background:var(--amber-soft);border-color:#FEDF89;} .tag.no{color:#B42318;background:var(--red-soft);border-color:#FECDCA;} .tag.info{color:var(--blue);background:var(--blue-soft);border-color:#C9E3B5;}
.num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;}

/* empty state */
.es{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;padding:36px 20px;}
.es .ei{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--sh);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:14px;} .es .ei svg{width:20px;height:20px;}
.es-t{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);} .es-s{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px;max-width:360px;line-height:1.5;}
.es .btn{margin-top:16px;}

.sys{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:12px;}
.sys-i{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:14px 16px;box-shadow:var(--sh);}
.sys-i .si{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:8px;background:#F9FAFB;color:var(--ink-2);border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;} .sys-i .si svg{width:17px;height:17px;}
.sys-i .k{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);} .sys-i .st{font-size:12.5px;color:#067647;font-weight:500;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.sys-i .st::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;}
.grp{margin-top:8px;} .grp-h{margin:0 0 12px;} .grp-h h3{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--muted);margin:0;}
.field{margin:12px 0;max-width:440px;} .field label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-2);margin-bottom:6px;}
.field .inp{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:1px solid #D0D5DD;border-radius:8px;padding:0 12px;background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--sh);}
.field .inp:focus-within{border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--ring);}
.field .inp svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--subtle);} .field input{border:none;outline:none;padding:9px 0;font:inherit;font-size:14px;flex:1;background:none;color:var(--ink);}
.flow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:8px 0 14px;} .flow .s{background:#F9FAFB;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:4px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-2);} .flow .ar{color:var(--subtle);font-weight:500;}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;}

.scrim{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(16,24,40,.5);z-index:54;}
.botnav{display:none;}
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(14px);background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(16,24,40,.18);opacity:0;transition:.22s;z-index:120;pointer-events:none;}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);}

/* ---------- Barre supérieure ---------- */
.app-topbar{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;height:56px;padding:0 24px 0 32px;background:var(--card);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);position:relative;z-index:30;}
.tb-crumb{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);min-width:0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.tb-crumb .tb-sep{color:#D0D5DD;}
.tb-crumb b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;}
.notif-wrap{position:relative;margin-left:auto;}
.notif-bell{position:relative;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--sh);transition:background .15s;}
.notif-bell:hover{background:#F9FAFB;}
.notif-bell svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:var(--ink-2);stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
.notif-count{position:absolute;top:-5px;right:-5px;min-width:18px;height:18px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;line-height:1;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff;}
.notif-count.hidden{display:none;}
.notif-panel{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 8px);right:0;width:380px;max-width:calc(100vw - 32px);max-height:min(70vh,520px);overflow:auto;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(16,24,40,.14);z-index:80;}
.notif-panel.hidden{display:none;}
.notif-panel-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--card);z-index:1;}
.notif-panel-head h4{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;margin:0;color:var(--ink);}
.notif-panel-head span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;}
.notif-list{padding:6px;}
.notif-empty{padding:30px 16px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px;}
.notif-item{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;}
.notif-item:hover{background:#F9FAFB;}
.notif-ic{flex:0 0 auto;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:var(--amber-soft);color:var(--amber);border:1px solid #FEDF89;}
.notif-ic svg{width:15px;height:15px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
.notif-ic.blue{background:var(--blue-soft);color:var(--blue);border-color:#C9E3B5;}
.notif-ic.red{background:var(--red-soft);color:var(--red);border-color:#FECDCA;}
.notif-body{flex:1;min-width:0;}
.notif-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);}
.notif-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;}
.notif-check{flex:0 0 auto;width:26px;height:26px;margin-top:2px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #D0D5DD;background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted);}
.notif-check:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green);background:var(--green-tint);}
.notif-check svg{width:13px;height:13px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
@media (max-width:820px){.app-topbar{padding:0 14px;height:52px;}.notif-panel{width:calc(100vw - 24px);right:-4px;}}

@media (max-width:1050px){ .g-2{grid-template-columns:1fr;} .kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;} }
@media (max-width:820px){
  .side{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;height:100vh;transform:translateX(-110%);transition:transform .22s ease;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.4);}
  .side.open{transform:none;} .scrim.show{display:block;}
  .botnav{display:flex;position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:50;background:var(--card);border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:6px 4px calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));justify-content:space-around;box-shadow:0 -4px 16px rgba(16,24,40,.05);}
  .bn{flex:1;background:none;border:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:4px 2px;color:var(--muted);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:500;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;}
  .bn svg{width:21px;height:21px;} .bn.active{color:var(--green);}
  .pages{bottom:60px;} .framehost{bottom:60px;}
}
@media (max-width:620px){
  .kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;} .view{padding:20px 16px 32px;}
  .kpi{padding:14px;} .kpi .v{font-size:22px;}
  table.tbl{min-width:0;} table.tbl thead{display:none;}
  table.tbl tr{display:block;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);} table.tbl tr:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  table.tbl td{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;border:none!important;padding:5px 16px;text-align:right;min-width:0;}
  table.tbl td::before{content:attr(data-label);color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;text-align:left;flex:0 0 auto;} table.tbl td[data-label=""]::before{content:none;}
  table.tbl td .tbl-inp{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;max-width:60%;}
  table.tbl tbody tr:hover td{background:none;}
}
.floader{color:var(--muted);}

.tarifs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:4px 32px;}
.tarif{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 150px 56px;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);}
.tarif:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.tarif .tn{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);}
.tarif input[type=range]{width:100%;accent-color:var(--green);}
.tarif .tv{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
@media(max-width:560px){.tarif{grid-template-columns:1fr 100px 52px;}}

.view .btn.green,.view .btn.green svg,.view .btn.dark,.view .btn.dark svg,.btn.green,.btn.green svg,.tag.green,.badge.green{color:#fff;}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ *{transition:none!important;animation:none!important;} }

/* ===== Pilotage semi-automatique ===== */
.todo-card .card-h .hint{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-2);background:#F2F4F7;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 10px;font-size:12px;}
.todo-card .card-h .hint:empty{display:none;}
.todo-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.todo-item{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);}
.todo-item:last-of-type{border-bottom:none;}
.todo-item .notif-ic{flex:0 0 auto;margin-top:1px;}
.todo-body{flex:1;min-width:0;}
.todo-title{font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.4;}
.todo-sub{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;}
.todo-acts{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:10px;}
.todo-acts .btn.sm{padding:5px 10px;font-size:12.5px;}
.todo-acts .todo-skip{background:transparent;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:none;color:var(--muted);}
.todo-acts .todo-skip:hover{color:var(--ink);background:#F2F4F7;}
.todo-empty{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:16px 0;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);}
.todo-empty svg{width:20px;height:20px;flex:0 0 auto;color:#12B76A;stroke-width:2.2;}
.todo-more{margin-top:8px;background:none;border:none;color:var(--green);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;padding:6px 0;cursor:pointer;}
.todo-more:hover{text-decoration:underline;}
.notif-ic.green{background:var(--green-tint);color:var(--green);border-color:#DDEBD3;}
.tag.late{background:var(--red-soft);color:#B42318;border-color:#FECDCA;}
.tag.todo{background:var(--blue-soft);color:var(--blue);border-color:#C9E3B5;}
.grp + .grid{margin-top:16px!important;}
@media(max-width:620px){.tb-crumb span{display:none;}}

/* ===== Motion design léger (compositeur uniquement : opacity + transform) ===== */
@keyframes mIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,4px,0);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}
@keyframes mFade{from{opacity:0;}to{opacity:1;}}
@keyframes mPop{from{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,-4px,0) scale(.98);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}
.view:not(.hidden){animation:mIn .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) backwards;}
/* Logiciels : l'iframe reste invisible pendant son chargement, puis apparaît en fondu */
.frames iframe{transition:opacity .22s ease-out;}
.frames iframe.active{animation:mFade .18s ease-out backwards;}
.floader.show ~ iframe{opacity:0!important;}
.floader.show{animation:mFade .2s ease .25s backwards;}
.notif-panel:not(.hidden){animation:mPop .16s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) backwards;transform-origin:top right;}
.kpi-link{transition:box-shadow .18s ease,border-color .18s ease,transform .18s ease;}
.kpi-link:hover{transform:translate3d(0,-1px,0);}
.btn,.side-btn,.notif-bell,.notif-check{transition:background-color .15s ease,border-color .15s ease,color .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease,transform .1s ease;}
.btn:active,.side-btn:active,.notif-bell:active,.notif-check:active{transform:scale(.98);}
.nav-item{transition:background-color .15s ease,color .15s ease;}
.nav-item svg{transition:color .15s ease;}
table.tbl tbody tr td{transition:background-color .12s ease;}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ *{transition:none!important;animation:none!important;} }
@media (max-width:820px){ .bn{min-width:0;white-space:nowrap;} }
@media (max-width:380px){ .bn{font-size:9.5px;} }

/* ===== Apporteurs : clients apportés + sélection ===== */
.cl-ap{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:400;margin-top:2px;}
#apporteursCard .card-h{flex-wrap:wrap;}
.ap-search{max-width:300px;box-shadow:none;}
.ap-search input{padding:7px 0;font-size:13px;}
.ap-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;max-width:420px;}
.ap-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;background:#F4F9F0;border:1px solid #C9E3B5;color:#3F7A23;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 4px 2px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;}
.ap-chip button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:transparent;color:#3F7A23;padding:0;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s ease;}
.ap-chip button:hover{background:#DFEFD3;}
.ap-chip button svg{width:11px;height:11px;stroke-width:2.4;}
.ap-add{padding:3px 9px!important;font-size:12px!important;border-style:dashed!important;box-shadow:none!important;color:var(--ink-2)!important;}
.ap-add svg{width:12px!important;height:12px!important;stroke-width:2.2;}
.ap-add:hover{border-color:var(--green)!important;color:var(--green)!important;border-style:solid!important;}
.ap-tbl tr.ap-total td{background:#F9FAFB;}
.pk-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:140;background:rgba(16,24,40,.5);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;}
.pk-overlay.open{display:flex;animation:mFade .16s ease-out backwards;}
.pk-modal{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;width:100%;max-width:480px;max-height:min(80vh,640px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 20px 48px rgba(16,24,40,.18);overflow:hidden;}
.pk-overlay.open .pk-modal{animation:mPop .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) backwards;}
.pk-h{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:18px 20px 12px;}
.pk-h h4{margin:0;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);}
.pk-h p{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);}
.pk-x{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px;border:none;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;}
.pk-x:hover{background:#F2F4F7;color:var(--ink);}
.pk-x svg{width:16px;height:16px;}
.pk-s{padding:0 20px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);}
.pk-l{overflow-y:auto;padding:6px 10px;flex:1;min-height:120px;}
.pk-i{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .12s ease;}
.pk-i:hover{background:#F9FAFB;}
.pk-i input{width:16px;height:16px;flex:0 0 auto;accent-color:var(--green);}
.pk-t{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;}
.pk-t b{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);}
.pk-t small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);}
.pk-t em{display:block;font-style:normal;color:var(--amber);}
.pk-e{padding:24px 10px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px;}
.pk-f{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;padding:12px 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-2);background:#F9FAFB;}
.pk-n{margin-right:auto;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);}
@media (max-width:620px){.ap-chips{max-width:none;justify-content:flex-end;}.ap-search{max-width:none;width:100%;}}
/* Liens contact (Maps / appel / Gmail) */
.cl-f{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;}
.cl-f .tbl-inp{flex:1 1 auto;}
.cl-lnk{flex:0 0 auto;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:var(--green);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;padding:0;transition:background-color .15s ease,border-color .15s ease;}
.cl-lnk:hover{background:var(--green-tint);border-color:#C9E3B5;}
.cl-lnk svg{width:14px;height:14px;}
a.ln{color:var(--green);font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;}
a.ln:hover{text-decoration:underline;}
.ap-tbl td{vertical-align:middle;}
.fe-b{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px 14px;padding:8px 20px 18px;overflow:auto;}
.fe-f{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-2,#344054);}
.fe-f input{width:100%;min-width:0;box-sizing:border-box;font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;border:1px solid #D0D5DD;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 11px;}
.fe-f input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--ring);}
@media(max-width:620px){.fe-b{grid-template-columns:1fr;}.fe-f input{font-size:16px;}}
@media (max-width:620px){.cl-f{justify-content:flex-end;max-width:70%;}}
.ap-tbl a.ln[href^="tel"]{white-space:nowrap;}

/* ===== Corrections d'affichage (audit) ===== */
/* Hauteur réelle de l'écran sur mobile (barre d'adresse) */
.app{height:100dvh;} .content{height:100dvh;}
/* Zones sûres iOS (encoche, barre d'état translucide, barre d'accueil) */
.app-topbar{padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top);height:calc(56px + env(safe-area-inset-top));}
#loginGate{padding-top:max(40px,env(safe-area-inset-top));padding-bottom:max(40px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));}
.toast{bottom:calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));}
/* Clients : champs éditables jamais écrasés (défilement horizontal du tableau si besoin) */
#clientsCard table.tbl th,#clientsCard table.tbl td{padding-left:12px;padding-right:12px;}
#clientsCard table.tbl th:first-child,#clientsCard table.tbl td:first-child{padding-left:20px;}
#clientsCard td[data-label="Client"]{min-width:140px;max-width:200px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}
#clientsCard select.tbl-inp{min-width:100px;}
#clientsCard .cl-f .tbl-inp{min-width:106px;max-width:200px;}
#clientsCard td[data-label="Email"] .cl-f .tbl-inp{min-width:116px;}
#clientsCard td[data-label="Adresse"] .cl-f .tbl-inp{min-width:136px;}
/* Tableau de bord tablette : la 3e carte occupe toute la largeur */
@media (min-width:721px) and (max-width:1100px){ .dash-row > .dcard:nth-child(3){grid-column:1/-1;} }
@media (max-width:820px){
  .app-topbar{height:calc(52px + env(safe-area-inset-top));}
  .side{height:100dvh;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top);}
  .pages,.framehost{bottom:calc(60px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));}
  .toast{bottom:calc(76px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));}
}
@media (max-width:620px){
  #clientsCard table.tbl td,#clientsCard table.tbl td:first-child{padding:5px 16px;}
  #clientsCard td[data-label="Client"]{min-width:0;max-width:none;}
  #clientsCard select.tbl-inp,#clientsCard .cl-f .tbl-inp,#clientsCard td[data-label="Adresse"] .cl-f .tbl-inp,#clientsCard td[data-label="Email"] .cl-f .tbl-inp{min-width:0;}
  table.tbl td > div{min-width:0;}
  table.tbl td[data-label=""]{justify-content:flex-end;}
  #paiementsCard .card-h{flex-wrap:wrap;}
  #paiementsCard .card-h > .row{width:100%;}
  .ap-tbl tr.ap-total td:empty{display:none;}
}
.dli:focus-visible,.dmore:focus-visible,.notif-item:focus-visible,#loginGate a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--green);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px;}
.note-tg{flex:0 0 auto;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:28px;height:28px;margin-left:-2px;padding:0;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;color:#667085;border-radius:7px;}
.note-tg span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:18px;height:18px;border:1px solid #98A2B3;border-radius:5px;font:600 14px/1 system-ui,sans-serif;transition:color .15s,border-color .15s,background .15s;}
.note-tg:hover span,.note-tg[aria-expanded="true"] span{color:var(--ink);border-color:#98A2B3;}
.note-tg:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:var(--ring);}
#notePanel{flex:0 0 auto;padding:10px 24px 8px 32px;background:var(--card);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
#notePanel[hidden]{display:none;}
#notePanel textarea{display:block;width:100%;min-height:64px;max-height:40vh;resize:vertical;font-family:inherit;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink);background:#FCFCFD;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 11px;box-sizing:border-box;}
#notePanel textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--ring);}
#notePanel .note-meta{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:5px;min-height:15px;}
@media (max-width:820px){#notePanel{padding:8px 14px 6px;}#notePanel textarea{font-size:16px;}}
#secoursBar{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:9px 24px 9px 32px;background:#FFFAEB;border-bottom:1px solid #FEDF89;color:#93370D;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;}
#secoursBar[hidden]{display:none;}
#secoursBar b{color:#7A2E0E;}
#secoursBar>span{flex:1 1 360px;min-width:0;}
#secoursBar .btn{white-space:nowrap;}
#secoursBar .btn{margin-left:auto;}
@media (max-width:820px){#secoursBar{padding:8px 14px;font-size:12.5px;}#secoursBar .btn{margin-left:0;}}
.sec-help{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;margin:12px 0 0;}
.sec-auto{margin-top:14px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--bg);font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-2);line-height:1.5;}
.sec-auto .row{margin-top:10px;}
.sec-auto b{color:var(--ink);}
</style>
<script src="supabase.js"></script>
<script>/* Secours : CDN à version exacte + contrôle d'intégrité si la copie locale est absente. */if(!(window.supabase&&window.supabase.createClient))document.write('<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.117.2/dist/umd/supabase.js" integrity="sha384-Rj26LVGvoeRVR6+mwQmFfcR3QOBEwT+ZmuCWpuiqeTzJpCs0ER4ITAWGb4Hiy3Ok" crossorigin="anonymous"><\/script>');</script>
<script>
if(!window.__SECOURS__&&"serviceWorker" in navigator){
  window.addEventListener("load",function(){
    navigator.serviceWorker.register("sw.js").catch(function(e){console.warn("SW registration failed:",e);});
  });
}
</script>
</head>
<body>
<div id="loginGate">
  <img class="lg-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Burdigala Diagnostics">
  <div class="lg-card">
    <form id="lgForm" autocomplete="on" novalidate>
      <div class="lg-err" id="lgErr"></div>
      <div class="lg-field">
        <label for="lgEmail">Email</label>
        <input class="lg-inp" type="email" id="lgEmail" name="email" autocomplete="username" required>
      </div>
      <div class="lg-field">
        <label for="lgPw">Mot de passe</label>
        <div class="lg-pw">
          <input class="lg-inp" type="password" id="lgPw" name="password" autocomplete="current-password" required>
          <button class="lg-see" type="button" id="lgSee" aria-label="Afficher le mot de passe">Voir</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button class="lg-cta" type="submit" id="lgGo">Se connecter</button>
      <div class="lg-switch"><span id="lgSwitchText">Pas encore de compte ?</span> <a id="lgSwitch" href="#" role="button">Créer un compte</a></div>
    </form>
    <div class="lg-switch" id="lgOfflineRow" style="margin-top:10px;"><a id="lgOffline" href="#" role="button">Continuer hors connexion</a></div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="app">
  <aside class="side" id="side">
    <button type="button" class="side-brand" id="brandHome" aria-label="Retour au tableau de bord"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Burdigala Diagnostics"></button>
    <nav class="side-nav">
      <div class="nsec">Pilotage</div>
      <button class="nav-item active" data-view="dashboard"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3.5" y="3.5" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"></rect><rect x="13.5" y="3.5" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"></rect><rect x="3.5" y="13.5" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"></rect><rect x="13.5" y="13.5" width="7" height="7" rx="1.5"></rect></svg>Tableau de bord</button>
      <div class="nsec">Logiciels</div>
      <button class="nav-item" data-view="devis"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 3.5h8L18.5 8v12a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V4.5a1 1 0 0 1 1-1Z"></path><path d="M13.5 3.6V8h4.4"></path></svg>Devis<span class="badge" id="nDevis">0</span></button>
      <button class="nav-item" data-view="compta"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M17.5 6.2A6 6 0 0 0 8.2 8.6M17.5 17.8A6 6 0 0 1 8.2 15.4M5 10.2h9M5 13.8h9"></path></svg>Comptabilité</button>
      <button class="nav-item" data-view="calendrier"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3.5" y="5" width="17" height="15.5" rx="2"></rect><path d="M3.5 9.5h17M8 3v3.5M16 3v3.5"></path></svg>Calendrier<span class="badge" id="nRdv">0</span></button>
      <button class="nav-item" data-view="prospection"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 21s6.5-5.5 6.5-10.2A6.5 6.5 0 0 0 5.5 10.8C5.5 15.5 12 21 12 21Z"></path><circle cx="12" cy="10.5" r="2.4"></circle></svg>Prospection</button>
      <div class="nsec">Données</div>
      <button class="nav-item" data-view="clients"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="9" cy="8" r="3.2"></circle><path d="M3.5 19c0-3 2.5-5 5.5-5s5.5 2 5.5 5"></path><path d="M16 5.2a3 3 0 0 1 0 5.8M20.5 19c0-2.4-1.4-4.2-3.6-4.8"></path></svg>Clients</button>
      <button class="nav-item" data-view="documents"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3.5 6.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 5 5h4l2 2.2h7.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 20 8.7V18a1.5 1.5 0 0 1-1.5 1.5H5A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 3.5 18Z"></path></svg>Documents</button>
      <button class="nav-item" data-view="paiements"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.5"></circle><path d="M12 7.5v5l3 2"></path></svg>Paiements<span class="badge" id="nPaiements">0</span></button>
      <button class="nav-item" data-view="parametres"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"></circle><path d="M19.4 13.5a7.8 7.8 0 0 0 0-3l1.7-1.3-1.8-3.1-2 .8a7.6 7.6 0 0 0-2.6-1.5L12.4 2h-3.6L8.5 4.1A7.6 7.6 0 0 0 5.9 5.6l-2-.8L2 7.9l1.7 1.3a7.8 7.8 0 0 0 0 3L2 13.5l1.9 3.1 2-.8a7.6 7.6 0 0 0 2.6 1.5L8.8 22h3.6l.3-2.1a7.6 7.6 0 0 0 2.6-1.5l2 .8 1.9-3.1Z"></path></svg>Paramètres</button>
    </nav>
    <div class="side-foot">
      <div class="side-actions">
        <button class="side-btn primary" id="topSync"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 8a8 8 0 0 1 13.7-4.2L20 6M20 4v3h-3M20 16a8 8 0 0 1-13.7 4.2L4 18M4 20v-3h3"></path></svg>Synchroniser</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </aside>
  <div class="scrim" id="scrim"></div>

  <div class="content">
    <div class="app-topbar">
      <div class="tb-crumb"><span>Burdigala Diagnostics</span><span class="tb-sep">/</span><b id="tbTitle">Tableau de bord</b><button class="note-tg" id="noteToggle" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="notePanel" title="Note de cette page"><span aria-hidden="true">+</span></button></div>
      <div class="notif-wrap" id="notifWrap">
        <button class="notif-bell" id="notifBell" type="button" aria-label="Notifications" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 3.5c-3.2 0-5.7 2.5-5.7 5.7v3.1c0 .6-.2 1.2-.6 1.7l-1.2 1.5c-.6.8 0 2 1 2h13c1 0 1.6-1.2 1-2l-1.2-1.5c-.4-.5-.6-1.1-.6-1.7V9.2c0-3.2-2.5-5.7-5.7-5.7Z"></path><path d="M9.8 20a2.3 2.3 0 0 0 4.4 0"></path></svg><span class="notif-count hidden" id="notifCount">0</span></button>
        <div class="notif-panel hidden" id="notifPanel">
          <div class="notif-panel-head"><h4>Notifications</h4><span id="notifPanelCount"></span></div>
          <div class="notif-list" id="notifList"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="notePanel" hidden><textarea id="noteText" rows="3" placeholder="Note pour cette page — enregistrée automatiquement" aria-label="Note de la page"></textarea><div class="note-meta" id="noteMeta"></div></div>
    <div id="secoursBar" role="status" hidden></div>
    <div class="body">
      <div class="pages" id="pages">

        <!-- DASHBOARD -->
        <section class="view" id="view-dashboard">
          <div class="hello">
            <div><h2>Bonjour Dany</h2><p id="dDate">Voici l'état de votre activité.</p></div>
          </div>

          <!-- Ligne 1 : à traiter -->
          <div class="dash-row r1">
            <div class="card dcard">
              <button class="dcard-h kpi-link" id="kpiDevis" type="button"><span class="ic amber"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 3.5h8L18.5 8v12H6Z"></path></svg></span><span class="t">Devis en attente</span><span class="v" id="kDevis">0</span></button>
              <div class="dlist" id="dashDevis"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="card dcard">
              <button class="dcard-h kpi-link" id="kpiToday" type="button"><span class="ic blue"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3.5" y="5" width="17" height="15.5" rx="2"></rect><path d="M3.5 9.5h17"></path></svg></span><span class="t">Rendez-vous aujourd'hui</span><span class="v" id="kToday">0</span></button>
              <div class="dlist" id="dashToday"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="card dcard">
              <button class="dcard-h kpi-link" id="kpiWait" type="button"><span class="ic amber"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.5"></circle><path d="M12 7.5v5l3 2"></path></svg></span><span class="t">Paiements en attente</span><span class="v" id="kWait">0 €</span></button>
              <div class="dlist" id="dashWait"></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Ligne 2 : indicateurs mois par mois -->
          <div class="dash-row">
            <div class="card dcard">
              <button class="dcard-h kpi-link" id="kpiCA" type="button"><span class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 18V9m5 9V6m5 12v-7m5 7V4"></path></svg></span><span class="t">CA encaissé HT<small id="kCAMois">ce mois-ci</small></span><span class="v" id="kCA">0 €</span></button>
              <div class="dsub" id="kCASub"></div>
              <div class="chart" id="chart"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="card dcard">
              <button class="dcard-h kpi-link" id="kpiClients" type="button"><span class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="9" cy="8" r="3.2"></circle><path d="M3.5 19c0-3 2.5-5 5.5-5s5.5 2 5.5 5"></path><path d="M16 11.5a2.8 2.8 0 1 0 0-5.6M17 14.2c2 .5 3.5 2.2 3.5 4.8"></path></svg></span><span class="t">Clients<small>au total · nouveaux par mois ci-dessous</small></span><span class="v" id="kClients">0</span></button>
              <div class="dsub" id="kClientsSub"></div>
              <div class="chart" id="chartClients"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="card dcard">
              <button class="dcard-h kpi-link" id="kpiDiags" type="button"><span class="ic blue"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12.5 10 17l9-10"></path></svg></span><span class="t">Diagnostics effectués<small id="kDiagsMois">ce mois-ci · 1 diagnostic payé = 1 effectué</small></span><span class="v" id="kDiags">0</span></button>
              <div class="dsub" id="kDiagsSub"></div>
              <div class="chart" id="chartDiags"></div>
            </div>
          </div>


          <div class="tree-strip" id="treeStrip" hidden></div>

          <div class="card todo-card" style="margin:16px 0 0;"><div class="card-h"><h3>À faire</h3><span class="hint" id="todoCount"></span></div><div class="card-b todo-list" id="todoList"></div></div>

          <div class="card" style="margin-top:16px;"><div class="card-h"><h3>Activité récente</h3></div><div class="card-b" id="dashAct"></div></div>
        </section>

        <!-- CLIENTS -->
        <section class="view hidden" id="view-clients">
          <div class="vhead"><p class="lead">Toutes les personnes ayant reçu au moins un devis.</p>
            <div class="search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"></circle><path d="m20 20-3.2-3.2"></path></svg><input id="cSearch" type="search" aria-label="Rechercher un client" placeholder="Rechercher un client, une commune…"></div></div>
          <div class="card" style="margin-top:14px" id="clientsCard"><div class="tbl-wrap"><table class="tbl"><thead><tr><th>Client</th><th>Type</th><th>Adresse</th><th>Téléphone</th><th>Email</th><th>Devis</th><th>CA</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody id="cRows"></tbody></table></div></div>
          <div class="card" style="margin-top:16px" id="apporteursCard"></div>
        </section>

        <!-- DOCUMENTS -->
        <section class="view hidden" id="view-documents">
          <div class="vhead"><p class="lead">Vos documents locaux : devis, factures et rapports.</p><div class="row" id="docF"></div></div>
          <div class="card" style="margin-top:14px" id="docsCard"><div class="tbl-wrap"><table class="tbl"><thead><tr><th>Document</th><th>Type</th><th>Client</th><th>Date</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody id="dRows"></tbody></table></div></div>
        </section>

        <!-- PAIEMENTS -->
        <section class="view hidden" id="view-paiements">
          <div class="vhead"><p class="lead">Tout ce qui reste à encaisser : factures émises non réglées et devis validés pas encore facturés. Cochez puis « Marquer payé » : la facture passe « payée » (ou est créée pour un devis) et le chiffre d'affaires se met à jour.</p></div>
          <div class="card" style="margin-top:14px" id="paiementsCard">
            <div class="card-h"><h3>À encaisser</h3><div class="row" style="gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap"><label for="payDate" style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)">Payé le</label><input type="date" id="payDate" class="tbl-inp" style="width:auto" aria-label="Date de paiement"><button class="btn dark" id="btnMarquerPaye" disabled="">Marquer payé</button></div></div>
            <div class="card-b"><div class="tbl-wrap"><table class="tbl"><thead><tr><th style="width:34px"><input type="checkbox" id="payAll" aria-label="Tout sélectionner"></th><th>Client</th><th>Document</th><th>Montant</th><th>Date</th><th>État</th></tr></thead><tbody id="payRows"></tbody></table></div></div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <!-- PARAMETRES -->
        <section class="view hidden" id="view-parametres">
          <div class="grp"><div class="grp-h"><h3>État du système</h3></div>
            <div class="sys">
              <div class="sys-i"><span class="si"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 3.5h8L18.5 8v12H6Z"></path></svg></span><div><div class="k">Devis</div><div class="st">Connecté</div></div></div>
              <div class="sys-i"><span class="si"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3.5" y="4.5" width="17" height="15" rx="2"></rect></svg></span><div><div class="k">Comptabilité</div><div class="st">Connecté</div></div></div>
              <div class="sys-i"><span class="si"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3.5" y="5" width="17" height="15.5" rx="2"></rect><path d="M3.5 9.5h17"></path></svg></span><div><div class="k">Calendrier</div><div class="st">Connecté</div></div></div>
              <div class="sys-i"><span class="si"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><ellipse cx="12" cy="6" rx="7.5" ry="3"></ellipse><path d="M4.5 6v12c0 1.7 3.4 3 7.5 3s7.5-1.3 7.5-3V6"></path></svg></span><div><div class="k">Stockage local</div><div class="st">Opérationnel</div></div></div>
              <div class="sys-i"><span class="si" style="background:var(--line-2);color:var(--muted)"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3.5 12a8.5 8.5 0 0 1 17 0"></path><path d="M12 20.5v-8"></path></svg></span><div><div class="k">Internet</div><div class="st" style="color:var(--muted)">non requis</div></div></div>
            </div></div>
          <div class="grid g-2" style="margin-top:8px">
            <div class="card" id="secoursCard"><div class="card-h"><h3>Sauvegarde &amp; secours</h3></div><div class="card-b">
              <p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-2);margin:10px 0 12px">En cas de panne du serveur ou sans réseau : un seul fichier qui contient le CRM complet et toutes vos données. Double-cliquez dessus, tout fonctionne hors ligne.</p>
              <div class="row"><button class="btn green" id="btnSecours"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 4v10m0 0 4-4m-4 4-4-4M5 18h14"></path></svg>Télécharger le CRM complet</button><button class="btn" id="btnMaj"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 8a8 8 0 0 1 13.7-4.2L20 6M20 4v3h-3M20 16a8 8 0 0 1-13.7 4.2L4 18M4 20v-3h3"></path></svg>Mettre à jour</button><button class="btn" id="btnExport"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 20V10m0 0 4 4m-4-4-4 4M5 6h14"></path></svg>Exporter les données</button></div>
              <input type="file" id="fileSync" accept=".json,.html,.htm,application/json,text/html" hidden="">
              <p class="sec-help"><b style="color:var(--ink-2)">Mettre à jour</b> : choisissez un export ou une copie de secours. Fusion : les nouveautés du fichier sont ajoutées et ses modifications reportées ; rien n'est supprimé ni dupliqué.</p>
              <div class="sec-auto" id="secoursAuto"></div>
            </div></div>
            <div class="card"><div class="card-h"><h3>Synchronisation entre appareils (cloud)</h3></div><div class="card-b">
              <p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-2);margin:10px 0 10px">Connectez-vous avec les mêmes identifiants sur votre téléphone et votre ordinateur : vos données se synchronisent automatiquement entre les deux.</p>
              <div id="cloudSetup">
                <div class="field"><label>URL du projet Supabase</label><div class="inp"><input id="cUrl" placeholder="https://xxxx.supabase.co" autocomplete="off"></div></div>
                <div class="field"><label>Clé publique (anon)</label><div class="inp"><input id="cAnon" placeholder="eyJ..." autocomplete="off"></div></div>
                <div class="row"><button class="btn green" id="btnCloudSetup">Enregistrer la configuration</button></div>
              </div>
              <div id="cloudAuthOut" style="display:none">
                <p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-2);margin:6px 0">La connexion se fait sur l'écran d'ouverture de l'application.</p>
              </div>
              <div id="cloudAuthIn" style="display:none">
                <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-2);margin:6px 0 10px">Connecté en tant que <b id="cloudUserEmail" style="color:var(--ink)"></b></div>
                <div style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:12px">Dernière synchro cloud : <b style="color:var(--ink)" id="cloudLastSync">jamais</b></div>
                <div class="row"><button class="btn" id="btnCloudPull">Récupérer maintenant</button><button class="btn" id="btnCloudEditCfg">Config…</button><button class="btn" id="btnCloudLogout">Se déconnecter</button></div>
              </div>
              <div id="cloudMsg" style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:10px"></div>
            </div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="card" style="margin-top:16px"><div class="card-h"><h3>Tarifs des diagnostics</h3></div><div class="card-b">
            <p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-2);margin:10px 0 14px">Ajustez la grille tarifaire appliquée dans le logiciel Devis, diagnostic par diagnostic. 0 % correspond au tarif de base.</p>
            <div id="tarifRows" class="tarifs"></div>
            <div class="row" style="margin-top:14px"><button class="btn green" id="btnTarifs">Appliquer aux devis</button><button class="btn" id="btnTarifsReset">Remettre à 0 %</button></div>
          </div></div>
          <div class="card" style="margin-top:16px"><div class="card-h"><h3>Données de l'application</h3></div><div class="card-b">
            <p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-2);margin:10px 0 12px">Vos données sont enregistrées automatiquement sur ce poste. Pensez à exporter une sauvegarde de temps en temps.</p>
            <div class="row"><button class="btn" id="btnReset" style="color:var(--red)"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 7h12M9 7V5h6v2M8 7l1 13h6l1-13"></path></svg>Réinitialiser l'application</button></div>
          </div></div>
        </section>

      </div>

      <div class="framehost" id="framehost">
        <div class="frames" id="frames">
          <div class="floader" id="floader"><div class="spin"></div>Chargement du module…</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<nav class="botnav" id="botnav">

    for(var n=el;n&&n!==document.body&&n!==document.documentElement;n=n.parentElement){

function regimeTVAAt(st,date){st=st||{};const d=String(date||todayISO()).slice(0,10);const ch=Array.isArray(st.regimeTVAChangements)?st.regimeTVAChangements:[];
